articles.headline: Fantasy football matchup rankings: Upgrade Tyler Warren, Tetairoa McMillan in Week 4
articles.description: The most and least favorable matchups in the NFL for this week's games at the four key fantasy positions.
articles.headlineJa: ファンタジー・フットボール対戦ランキング：第4週はタイラー・ウォーレンとテタイロア・マクミランを評価上方修正
articles.descriptionJa: 今週のNFLの試合における、ファンタジーフットボールの主要4ポジションでの最も有利な対戦と最も不利な対戦を紹介。
articles.body:
Making tough lineup decisions each week can be the most challenging part of fantasy football. When you're torn between two similar players, start the player with the superior matchup.

But exactly how does one determine the best (and worst) weekly matchups?

The matchup rankings provide a schedule-independent method to evaluate positional matchups, ranking all 32 opposing defenses in order of most to least favorable for opposing players at all four skill positions. Instead of relying upon seasonal totals, we calibrate points-allowed data to show how each defense fared relative to the difficulty of the schedule it has faced. 

For Week 4, 2026 full-season data is used, but once five weeks are in the books, only the most recent five weeks' numbers will be used.

"Adj. FPA," or Adjusted Fantasy Points Allowed, reflects how far above or below players' weekly PPR fantasy point averages that defense held opponents at that position. A positive number means that the matchup is favorable; a negative number means it is unfavorable.

Finally, a caveat: Matchups are only one ingredient in my rankings formula. Not every favorable matchup should be exploited, nor unfavorable matchup avoided. If you want the most complete source for whom to start, consult our weekly rankings.

Quarterbacks

Matchups highlight: Jared Goff, Detroit Lions (at Carolina Panthers, "Sunday Night Football"). One the more quietly reliable quarterbacks, Goff joins Josh Allen, Brock Purdy and Tyler Shough among four with at least 16 fantasy points in each of the season's first three weeks. Of those four, he's the only one who hasn't been intercepted. Goff next faces the Panthers defense, which, aside from their 24-point Week 2 against the Atlanta Falcons third- and fourth-string quarterbacks, has been beaten up by the position. Caleb Williams (Week 1) and Deshaun Watson (Week 3) combined averaged 0.59 fantasy points per passing attempt -- the league average is 0.45 -- against the Panthers.

Others to like:

Trevor Lawrence, Jacksonville Jaguars (at Cincinnati Bengals)

Bryce Young, Panthers (at Lions, SNF)

Matchup to avoid: Jalen Hurts, Philadelphia Eagles (vs. Los Angeles Rams). He's off to a so-so start despite facing a favorable September schedule (WSH, @TEN, @CHI), due to inconsistent protection -- the Eagles rank 22nd in pass block win rate -- and a running game that hasn't fully launched (13th-ranked 110.7 yards per game, 19th-ranked 9.2% explosive run rate). That's of concern when Hurts faces the Rams, who rank second in yards allowed per passing attempt (5.2) and ninth in Total QBR allowed (53.2). Hurts' mobility presents his best case for a top-10 positional ranking this week, but aim to do better from that lineup slot.

articles.headline: Sources: Ravens starting center Jovaughn Gwyn set to miss months
articles.description: Ravens starting center Jovaughn Gwyn is expected to miss two to three months with a fractured fibula that will likely require surgery, a source told ESPN.
articles.headlineJa: 関係者によると、レイブンズの先発Cジョヴォーン・グウィンが数か月離脱の見込み
articles.descriptionJa: レイブンズの先発センター、ジョヴォーン・グウィンは腓骨骨折を負い、手術が必要となる見込みで2〜3か月の離脱が予想されていると関係者がESPNに明かした。
articles.body:
OWINGS MILLS, Md. -- Baltimore Ravens starting center Jovaughn Gwyn is expected to miss two to three months with a fractured fibula that will likely require surgery, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler on Wednesday.

Gwyn was carted off the field during the Ravens' 34-31 win over the Dallas Cowboys in the NFL's first game in Rio de Janeiro.

With backup center Ethan Pocic (knee) also injured, Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Monday that rookie first-round pick Olaivavega Ioane is preparing to make his first start at center for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans. Ioane, the No. 14 overall pick in this year's draft, has started the first three games of the season at right guard.

The Ravens have started to look for offensive line help, working out centers Graham Glasgow and Kingsley Eguakun along with guard Kyle Hergel on Tuesday.

Gwyn, 27, was a starter for the first time in his four-year career when he beat out Pocic for the job in training camp. A seventh-round pick in 2023, he had played his first three seasons as a reserve with the Atlanta Falcons.

Gwyn's injury is the latest setback for the Ravens in their attempt to replace Tyler Linderbaum, a three-time Pro Bowler who became the NFL's highest-paid center when he signed a three-year, $81 million contract with the Las Vegas Raiders in March. Danny Pinter suffered a season-ending knee injury in August after it looked like he was going to win Baltimore's starting center job.

articles.descriptionJa: マンチェスター・シティがプレミアリーグの財務ルール違反100件以上で有罪となったことを受け、ペップ・グアルディオラ監督が初の声明を発表し、「私は自分のクラブを全面的に支持する」と語った。
articles.body:
Pep Guardiola has released his first statement since Manchester City were found guilty of over 100 breaches of Premier League financial rules, saying "I am behind my club."

Guardiola's full statement on Wednesday read: "I want every single Manchester City fan across the world to know I am here; more than ever. I am, always have been, always will, be behind my club, my owner, my chairman, Ferran, the players, staff, Enzo and you, our unique supporters.

"Let me be clear: we will get through this together. I love you all."

articles.headline: Can the Broncos keep pulling off unlikely comeback victories?
articles.description: Somehow, the Broncos keep finding ways to overcome their slow first-half starts, pulling off frenetic second-half comeback wins -- including in Week 3 against the Rams.
articles.headlineJa: ブロンコスは奇跡的な逆転勝利を収め続けることができるか？
articles.descriptionJa: ブロンコスは、第3週のラムズ戦を含め、前半のスロースタートを克服する方法をどうにか見つけ出し、後半の猛烈な逆転勝利を重ね続けている。
articles.body:
ENGLEWOOD, Colo. -- The Denver Broncos have found the most improbable comfort zone. This past Sunday night's 30-26 victory over the Los Angeles Rams was the fourth time in Sean Payton's three-plus-season tenure as head coach the Broncos have won a game in which they were behind 14 or more points in the second half.

"This team rises," safety Talanoa Hufanga said.

Quarterback Bo Nix added that team's high-wire dance "feels like our DNA."

Hufanga and Nix's comments form a pushback against proven concepts such as regression to the mean or the thought that past results don't guarantee future performance. And yet another comeback win might be rejecting the common-sense belief that the Broncos can't keep winning in this fashion.

But this past Sunday was the 10th time since Nix was drafted in 2024 that the Broncos have produced a fourth-quarter comeback victory. And it marked the first time in franchise history the Broncos have had consecutive comeback wins in which they trailed by double-digits in the second half (Denver overcame a 10-point, third-quarter deficit to beat the Jacksonville Jaguars in Week 2).

The Broncos (2-1) have developed a reputation for being second-half escape artists. But as they get set to face the undefeated San Francisco 49ers (3-0) on the road Sunday (4:25 p.m. ET, Levi's Stadium, CBS), how do they really feel about their current trend of overcoming lackluster first halves to win in late, dramatic fashion?

Payton tried to add some perspective moments after the Rams win, saying that a start like the Broncos had against Los Angeles -- in which they were outgained 273-67 in the first half while falling behind 16-0 -- would be "something we're frustrated about later if we don't get it cleaned up." And "later" could mean as soon as Sunday, given 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy leads the NFL in QBR (93.8) and touchdown passes (nine) while throwing only one interception.

The 49ers lead the league in offensive efficiency by a margin of more than 14 points over the second-place Buffalo Bills, who are closer to seventh place than they are to San Francisco. The Niners also lead the NFL in offensive expected points added (EPA) by a little more than 15 points, with the No. 2 team (Buffalo) being closer to No. 8 than it is to the 49ers. So, the Broncos, who have scored only 10 first-half points this season, would rather not be forced rely on a third straight escape act.

"We'll look at the tape [of Sunday's win] and I'm sure and pull our hair out with some stuff," Payton said. "And be excited about some things, too"

While it's not ideal, the Broncos can be excited about their ability to recover and thrive in seemingly hopeless situations. And the win over the Rams was among their most improbable.

articles.headline: Does Man City's guilty verdict impact Pep Guardiola's legacy as an all-time coaching great?
articles.description: Pep Guardiola won 16 major honors as Man City manager. They all now count for nothing after the Premier League found the club guilty of systematically breaking financial rules.
articles.headlineJa: マンCの有罪判決は、史上最高の名将ペップ・グアルディオラのレガシーに影響を与えるのか？
articles.descriptionJa: ペップ・グアルディオラ監督はマンCで16の主要タイトルを獲得した。しかし、プレミアリーグが同クラブによる組織的な財務ルール違反を認定したため、それらはすべて無意味なものとなってしまった。
articles.body:
Pep Guardiola won 16 major honors during his 10-year reign as Manchester City manager before he left in the summer. They all now count for nothing.

Under Guardiola, City won a Champions League-Premier League-FA Cup treble. They became the only club in English history to win four successive league titles. They were the first team to achieve a domestic treble, and the only side to win the title by amassing 100 points. All of it was built on a false premise.

To borrow a phrase from the Premier League statement which condemned the club's "systematic rule-breaking for almost a decade" following an independent commission's finding that City were guilty of more than 100 breaches of rules between 2009-2018, it was all a "sham."

- Marcotti: Hard to see how City recover from extraordinary guilty verdict

- Dawson: Man City's guilt the talk of the town around English soccer

- Watch: Full reaction to 'the biggest sporting cheating scandal ever'

The egregious actions of City's owners -- Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed al Nahyan's Abu Dhabi United Group (ADUG) -- and executives has destroyed the reputation of a 146-year-old football club. City have said they will appeal the verdict and they maintain they are innocent, but Guardiola cannot escape the damage caused by a prolonged and systematic program of financial deception because much of it was done for his benefit.

Abu Dhabi built a club and a team fit for Guardiola, but it was a construction built by ill-gotten gains. The advantages Guardiola had at his disposal are now proven to have been unfair. As former Manchester United captain Roy Keane said this week: "They [City] won it on the pitch because cheating was going on."

Financial mismanagement, chicanery, deception -- whatever you want to call it, the foundations of Guardiola's City empire are rooted in the rule-breaking that happened before and during his time as manager, so his record-breaking era at the club is tainted by all of it.

But there are two sides to the Guardiola story at City. The former Barcelona and Bayern Munich coach arrived at the Etihad in the summer of 2016 having already won six league titles in Catalonia and Bavaria, as well as two Champions Leagues with Barça. His status as the world's pre-eminent coach was already secure.

Guardiola is a coaching genius, a man whose tactical brilliance built arguably the world's greatest-ever club side at Barcelona. He re-invented the way football was played, and his influence is now seen at every level of the game.

It's why City's Abu Dhabi hierarchy, led by Sheikh Mansour and club chairman Khaldoon Al Mubarak -- who is also CEO of Mubadala, Abu Dhabi's sovereign wealth fund, and holds senior positions within the Abu Dhabi government -- made such strenuous efforts to hire Guardiola in the first place.

articles.headline: Fantasy basketball: The pros and cons of points, roto and category leagues
articles.description: Which fantasy basketball scoring format should you play? Jim McCormick breaks down the most popular options so you can choose for yourself.
articles.headlineJa: ファンタジーバスケ：ポイント制、ロト制、カテゴリー制リーグのメリットとデメリット
articles.descriptionJa: どのファンタジーバスケのスコア形式でプレイすべきか？ジム・マコーミックが最も人気のあるフォーマットを解説し、自分に合ったものを選べるように紹介します。
articles.body:
They often say in boxing that styles make fights. The idiom suggests that unique approaches and strategies to the same sport can prove compelling. A southpaw slugger against a quick-footed righty adds to the sweetness of the science.

In a fantasy sports context, formats make things more fun.

When it comes to fantasy basketball, some managers are drawn to a season-long balancing act; curating each statistical category to remain competitive in 3-pointers while also making sure to have enough rim protection. Such managers would be ideal for rotisserie (roto) leagues -- or weekly head-to-head category leagues -- where statistical balance across your roster is the ultimate goal.

Others might prefer to compete in something closer to the fantasy football experience; which we call points leagues in fantasy hoops. These leagues lean on a scoring legend that rewards a specific number of points for each stat accumulated (one point for a rebound, four points for a block, for instance). Check out ESPN's default scoring for points leagues to better understand how this format values each category.

With this in mind, we've done some of the work for you; laying out the pros and cons of roto/category and points-driven formats to help refine the process. The good news is that you can also choose to play in each of these unique formats if you participate in multiple leagues.

How do Roto and H2H Category leagues work?

Roto leagues

Using a 10-team roto league as an example, the team that has the most steals by the end of the season earns 10 points, while the least-larcenous team is left with a single point. This is true for each of the categories your league employs.

Each starting roster spot is afforded an 82-game limit, so maximizing games played isn't an applicable angle in the vein that it fuels success in weekly head-to-head competition. That said, you don't want to fall behind too far in games logged, either, as your competition might end up many games ahead once spring arrives.

As for the specific categories your roto or categories league selects, it's advisable to go with a traditional eight-category setup (points, rebounds, steals, blocks, assists, 3-pointers and both field goal and free throw percentages) versus including turnovers, which are ultimately a tax on ball-dominant players. Some possible additions for a ninth category: assist-to-turnover ratio, which considers turnovers but also values efficient distribution and ball-security, or double-doubles, which put more emphasis on bigs who can rebound.

In roto, the team with the highest total of cumulative points in across each category takes home the title. There are no playoffs or late-season upsets to consider, as we must in weekly head-to-head leagues. This does not mean the format isn't exciting or compelling; roto merely demands a season-long grind from managers. articles.body:
We're onto Week 4 of the 2026 NFL season, and insiders Jeremy Fowler and Dan Graziano have been making calls to sources around the league for the latest news and notable buzz.

Drake Maye and the Patriots had an ugly game Sunday, but Maye is hardly the only quarterback with a concerning start to the season. Dan and Jeremy asked around the league to get a sense of which QBs land on the early-season panic meter. And after J.J. McCarthy kicked off trading season Monday in going to the Giants, our insiders poked around on more QB trades that could be on deck. Any other passers potentially switching teams?

Additionally, is the league buying the 3-0 start from the Raiders, who have already matched their win total from 2025? Can Las Vegas keep this up? And which teams -- 3-0 or otherwise -- are getting hit particularly hard with injuries? It's all here, as Jeremy and Dan answer big questions, hand out useful fantasy football nuggets and empty their reporting notebooks heading into Week 4.

Jump to:

Raiders' start | Injury impact

Fantasy football advice

Which QB currently sits atop the league's panic meter?

Fowler: Three come to mind here -- Drake Maye, Cam Ward and Justin Herbert. All three garner varying degrees of panic, but I'm putting Maye on top for now. The Year 3 regression is startling. He looks shaken right now. Mike Vrabel's comment after the 35-6 loss to Jacksonville was blunt: "My concern level is very high for this football team." Maye is a big part of that after six interceptions in three games. The next day, Vrabel questioned whether the Patriots' offense needs to scale back its game plans a bit, essentially to do less but do it better.

Still, the notion that Maye's play can improve is there. He was considered one of the cleanest quarterback prospects of the past half-decade when he entered the 2024 draft. He played at an MVP level less than a calendar year ago. And to be sure, the Patriots have not played well around Maye and have not adequately protected him, and wide receiver A.J. Brown's absence is deeply felt. The passing game was designed to feed him the ball often. Josh McDaniels' scheme is also considered to be complex for young passers.

But dating to last year's playoffs, Maye's seven-game production line is 120-of-200 passing for 1,413 yards, seven touchdowns and 10 interceptions. Those are 1970s QB numbers -- and jarring for a quarterback seemingly on the door of superstardom (to be fair, four of those seven were playoff games against top-shelf defenses).

So, I'm leaving the door open for Maye to fix it, but the panic can be found in Vrabel's voice right now. I mean, this team was in the Super Bowl last season, so the expectations couldn't have been higher. Perhaps last season's soft schedule masked a quarterback who was still very much in development.

articles.headline: Ex-Man City chairman calls for club's directors to resign after Premier League guilty verdict
articles.description: Former Manchester City chairman David Bernstein has called for the club's directors to step down after City were found guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules.
articles.headlineJa: マンC元会長、プレミアリーグの有罪判決を受けクラブ役員の辞任を要求
articles.descriptionJa: マンチェスター・シティがプレミアリーグの財務ルールに対する重大な違反で有罪と判断されたことを受け、同クラブの元会長デビッド・バーンスタイン氏は取締役陣の辞任を求めました。
articles.body:
Former Manchester City chairman David Bernstein has called for the club's directors to step down after City were found guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules.

The league announced in a statement on Tuesday that City had been found guilty on all charges related to the period between 2009 and 2018, with league CEO Richard Masters saying that the club "systematically broke Premier League rules for nearly a decade."

City said in a statement on Tuesday that they will appeal the verdict.

"I can't think of a penalty strong enough for this, really. I mean, this is absolutely terrible," Bernstein, who was chairman of the club between 1998 and 2003, told talkSPORT.

"I want to raise another question, and that is the position of the board of directors. Because the directors of the club, including the chief executive, who's been there for years and went through this period, are responsible for the running of the club in every respect.

"If this was a public company of some sort, I think the directors, with something as serious as this, would have to stand down or be suspended pending the outcome of all this ... Appeal or no appeal.

"I don't think the present management can credibly continue."

Asked in a separate interview with the BBC whether City's actions constituted fraud, Bernstein suggested that he felt the actions of the board merited a legal investigation.

"I would go that far, yes," he said. "And if it is, -- I'm not a lawyer, and I'm only just putting this on the table as a thought, really -- but it is something that is so serious that it goes beyond the football authorities. It is damning beyond belief.

Bernstein, who is a lifelong City fan, also suggested that the club should be removed from the Premier League.

- Man City to appeal guilty verdict in Premier League breaches case

- Man City should be stripped of titles - Jamie Carragher

- Man City CEO says Premier League verdict part of 'conspiracy'

"If [City's appeal] drags on for a year or two, heaven forbid, that would be the worst thing for everybody," he told talkSPORT.

"But if it did, then you'd have a different situation. So it's a little difficult to predict. But all I would say is that money [a financial penalty] is not sufficient now.

"But if these charges stand now and let's say the appeal does not happen or fails, then I'm afraid for the club I love that they've got to come out of the Premier League. This is beyond awful."

articles.headlineJa: ジーノ・スミスの好スタートがジェッツにとっての明るい話題である理由
articles.descriptionJa: チームは1勝2敗にとどまっているものの、35歳のQBはパス成功率75%以上を記録している。

articles.headline: Man City should be stripped of titles - Jamie Carragher
articles.description: Manchester City should be stripped of the titles won during the period where they have been found guilty of breaching Premier League financial rules, Jamie Carragher said
articles.headlineJa: ジェイミー・キャラガー氏「マンチェスター・シティはタイトルを剥奪されるべき」
articles.descriptionJa: ジェイミー・キャラガー氏は、マンチェスター・シティがプレミアリーグの財務規則に違反したと認められた期間に獲得したタイトルについて、剥奪されるべきだと述べました。

articles.headline: NBA issues new guidelines, instructs refs to crack down on push-offs
articles.description: The NBA has issued new guidance to its referees on four types of "high-volume and highly impactful" calls, including push-offs.
articles.headlineJa: NBAが新ガイドラインを発表、審判にプッシュオフの厳格な取り締まりを指示
articles.descriptionJa: NBAは審判に対し、プッシュオフを含む「発生頻度が高く、影響の大きい」4種類のファウル判定に関する新たな指導を行いました。

articles.headline: Kessler talks up Lakers' title hopes behind 'nasty' defense
articles.description: New addition Walker Kessler is convinced the Lakers have the right guys to be "a nasty defensive team" and a contender in the Western Conference this season.
articles.headlineJa: ケスラー、「エグい」守備を武器にレイカーズの優勝への期待を語る
articles.descriptionJa: 新加入のウォーカー・ケスラーは、今季のレイカーズには「強力でエグい守備チーム」となり、ウェスタン・カンファレンスの優勝争いに加わるための適切なメンバーが揃っていると確信しています。

articles.headline: Sources: NBA reviewing bids from three finalists for Vegas team
articles.description: The NBA is expected to select the winning bid for owner of the Las Vegas expansion team from among three finalist groups: Nancy Walton Laurie and Bill Laurie; Steve Apostolopoulos and Marc Lasry; and Bill Foley and Jerry Colangelo.
articles.headlineJa: 情報筋：NBA、ベガス新球団創設に向けて最終候補3組の買収提案を審査中
articles.descriptionJa: NBAは、ラスベガスの拡充チームのオーナー決定に向け、ナンシー・ウォルトン・ローリー＆ビル・ローリー組、スティーブ・アポストロポロス＆マーク・ラスリー組、ビル・フォーリー＆ジェリー・コランジェロ組の最終候補3グループの中から落札者を選定する見込みです。

articles.headline: NBA preseason buzz: Latest on trades, news and intel
articles.description: The NBA regular season is less than a month away, and we're tracking all the news, deals, and trades across the league.
